title: Read-only missing-work build route proposal
goal: Map only MISSING_WORK preflight decisions to a deterministic local-first Switchyard route proposal without invoking a model or worker.
laws: NO_CHANGE and BLOCKED never receive a build route.
Route proposal consumes the existing Switchyard selection result; it does not invent provider policy.
Selected labor must be available and PRIMARY for automatic local route proposal.
Output is read-only, authenticated when exposed through Command Deck, and executionStarted remains false.
